programmes.d: Semifinal Saturday spotlights the Top 50 competing for a place in the Top 10, as Santee Cooper’s grass-filled waters and big-bite potential continue to deliver dramatic swings in leaderboard standings.

Johnston not only secured his second Elite Series win, following his 2020 triumph on the St. Lawrence River, but also captured his second Century Belt, becoming the third angler to earn the distinction on both smallmouth and largemouth fisheries.
It's Championship Day on the 1984 Hudson River Invitational in Catskill, New York. Tune in to see who rises above the rest to claim the top spot and bring home the Bassmaster Elite Series trophy.

It's the final day of the 1984 Missouri Invitational on Truman Lake in Warsaw, Missouri. Charlie Ingram and Larry Williams go head to head from wire-to-wire, but only one angler can walk away as the champion. Don't miss the final moments to see who is crowned champion.

The 1985 Texas Memorial Invitational is nearing its conclusion at the Sam Rayburn Reservoir in Sam Rayburn, Texas. Watch along as the top anglers in the world compete to see who ascends to hoist the trophy and take home the glory.

The 1985 Super B.A.S.S. IV Tournament becomes an instant all-time classic as Hank Parker and Gary Klein have a showdown on the St. Johns River in Palatka, Florida. Tune in to see who emerges victorious and cements themselves in Bassmaster history.

In Chattanooga, Tennessee, the 1985 Bassmaster Series continues with the Chattanooga Invitational, where only one angler can claim the $100,000 prize. See who rises above the rest to claim the top spot and bring home the Bassmaster Elite Series trophy.

Lake Okeechobee's legacy is cemented during the 1985 Bassmaster Series as anglers make their mark in Clewiston, Florida as the Florida Invitational comes to a close. Only one angler can stand above the rest, tune in to find out who brings home the trophy and the $100,000 prize.

The 1986 New York Invitational on the St. Lawrence River continues the Bassmaster Series in Clayton, New York. Jimmy Houston and Mickey Bruce take part in an all-time race to see who takes home the top prize and cements themselves in the legacy of the New York Invitational.

Join host Ray Scott as the Bassmasters tour heads to Georgia’s scenic Lake Lanier for a high-stakes invitational. Watch top anglers battle unpredictable spring conditions and fierce competition in pursuit of the coveted title. Featuring expert tips, dramatic weigh-ins, and a nail-biting finish as Gary Klein edges out the field by just two ounces.

The Super Invitational continues in 1986 on the Tennessee River in Chattanooga, Tennessee, where the top anglers in the world compete to see who will bring home the top prize. Follow along to find out who of the top anglers will rise above the rest.

The Bassmasters tour heads north to the historic Hudson River for a thrilling invitational in Catskills, NY. Watch elite anglers battle tidal currents and urban waters in pursuit of bass glory. David Fenton emerges victorious with a razor-thin margin, outlasting legends like Larry Nixon and Fish Fishburne. Hosted by Ray Scott, this episode delivers intense competition, expert commentary, and scenic river views.

Join host Ray Scott and the Bassmaster crew as 250 of the nation’s top anglers descend on Florida’s legendary Lake Okeechobee. In this fall showdown, Charles “Slow-Hand” Murphy uses finesse and patience to outlast the competition and land a career-defining win.

The 1987 Texas Invitational is an all-time classic, taking place on the Sam Rayburn Invitational in Sam Rayburn, Texas. Watch along as top anglers compete to see who can make the most of a high-pressure situation and emerge victorious.

Anglers from across the world converge on Guntersville, Alabama to compete in the 1987 Alabama Invitation on Lake Guntersville. Fast-paced fishing adds pressure to every cast - but only one will walk away with the crown.

The Super Invitational on Kentucky Lake in Paris, Tennessee brings one of the most dominant performances in Bassmaster Series history. Tune in to see who gets hot and leads wire-to-wire, casting a pitch-perfect weekend and taking home the top prize.
The Team Championship on the St. Lawrence River in Clayton, New York brings teams together to see who can rise to the top. Tune in to see who brings home the top spot.

St. Lawrence River has become a staple for the Bassmaster Series, bringing the top anglers in the world back to Clayton, New York for another chance to see who takes the crown. See who unlocks the bit and takes home one of the most coveted prizes in bass fishing.

The 1987 Georgia Invitational takes place in LaGrange, Georgia, where a two angler race takes place. Will Tom Mann bring home the trophy, or will hot-on-his-heels Rick Clunn come from behind and steal the win away on West Point Lake in this Bassmaster Series tournament?

In this thrilling installment of Bassmasters, 250 elite anglers converge on Florida’s famed Lake Okeechobee for the Top 100 Pro-Am. Watch as Ron Shuffield, the underdog from Arkansas, redeems a poor showing from the previous year with a masterful performance, hauling in over 60 pounds of bass. Featuring intense competition, expert commentary, and the strategic use of lipless crankbaits in pepper grass, this episode captures the grit and glory of tournament fishing.

Sam Rayburn, Texas has become a mainstay for the Bassmaster Series, with the 1988 Texas Invitational giving way to an all-time four-angler race. Will Shaw Grigsby or Zell Rowland bring home the top prize, or could Jerry Rhyne or Jim Nolan come from behind to take the win?

Bull Shoals Lake in Bull Shoals, Arkansas joins other incredible lakes as home to a Basssmaster Series tournament location, where anglers try to cement themselves in the legacy of Bassmaster. Watch along to witness the end of an all-time Bassmaster tournament.

The Bassmaster tour heads to Alabama’s legendary Lake Guntersville for a springtime showdown among the nation’s top anglers. Don Snider rises to the occasion, mastering the lake’s grass beds and ledges to haul in over 47 pounds of bass.

It's Championship Sunday for the 1988 Missouri Invitational On Truman Lake in Warsaw, Missouri. See which of the top anglers in the world rises above the rest to claim the crown and leave with the top prize.

The Bassmaster pros take on the sprawling waters of Kentucky Lake in this late-season showdown. With cold fronts rolling in and bass holding tight to structure, Jim Kirkpatrick rises above the field with a strategic approach and steady execution, landing nearly 44 pounds of bass.

The Bassmaster Top 100 Pro-Am returns to Florida’s famed Lake Okeechobee, where legendary angler Paul Elias puts on a clinic in deep-water strategy and flipping finesse. With over 53 pounds of bass caught across four days, Elias secures a commanding win in a field packed with top-tier talent.

Clayton, New York becomes home to the top anglers in the world when the Bassmaster Series heads to Lake St. Lawrence for the 1989 New York Invitational. Will Richard Garlock bring home the top prize, or will Mickey Bruce catch fire and take the podium in the end?

The Bassmaster tour makes its debut on the Potomac River, where tidal waters and hurricane threats challenge even the most seasoned pros. Guido Hibdon, fresh off his Classic win, navigates the shifting conditions with finesse and strategy, landing over 43 pounds of bass to secure victory.

The Bassmaster tour heads west to the desert oasis of Lake Havasu, where clear water and rocky structure challenge the nation’s top anglers. Ted Miller rises to the occasion, using precision casting and strategic lure selection to land over 23 pounds of bass and secure a narrow victory.
